05 — Core website production

Build the website.
Test it with your team.

First, agree the pages and content. Then build the website in WordPress, test it and fix any problems before launch. SEO-page work starts after Elite Fit approves the core website.

  1. 01

    Plan and write

    Agree the page list and what each page needs to say. Prepare page layouts and original copy.

  2. 02

    Design and build

    Design and build 12–15 pages in WordPress. Your team can edit the approved page content.

  3. 03

    Test and approve

    Check mobile use, links, forms, accessibility and speed. Fix problems, check them again, then get Elite Fit’s approval.

  4. 04

    Support and hand over

    Support launch, fix reported issues for two months, then provide an editing guide and hand over the site.

06 — Website development scope and deliverables · D01–D02

Website development scope and deliverables

12–15 editable WordPress pages, with design, original copy, build, testing and handover.

View website deliverables and proposed pages
  1. 01
    Home

    Introduce Elite Fit and guide visitors to their next step.

  2. 02
    About Elite Fit

    Explain the club, its approach and what visitors can expect.

  3. 03
    Gym & Facilities

    Show the spaces, equipment and facilities.

  4. 04
    Memberships

    Present approved membership options and how to join.

  5. 05
    Passes

    Explain approved pass options and how to buy or book.

  6. 06
    Personal Training

    Explain training options and enquiry routes.

  7. 07
    Recovery

    Present recovery services and booking routes.

  8. 08
    Classes

    Explain the class offering and who each class suits.

  9. 09
    Class Timetable

    Help visitors find a suitable class and booking route.

  10. 10
    Trainers

    Introduce the team using approved profiles.

  11. 11
    Café

    Present the café and approved visitor information.

  12. 12
    Contact & Visit

    Provide location details, contact options and an enquiry form.

Confirm the final 12–15-page list at kickoff. The agreed pages are included in the fixed scope.

Included for each core page

  • Agree each page’s purpose, layout and design.
  • Write original copy, check the facts and get approval.
  • Design for phones and computers, using approved images or media.
  • Build editable WordPress pages with links and clear next steps.
  • Set each page’s title, search-result description, headings and standard settings.
  • Check the copy, phone layout, links and forms before approval.

Included across the website

  • Reusable design templates based on the Elite Fit brand guide.
  • Navigation, enquiry forms and agreed visitor journeys.
  • Existing approved booking/pass links or supplied embeds.
  • Test the site, fix issues, check them again, prepare launch and provide two months of support.
  • Editing guidance and website handover.

07 — SEO page scope and deliverables · D05–D13

SEO page scope and deliverables

A researched topic, original copy and an approved, fully built page.

  1. 01

    Research searches

    See what people search for and what they hope to find.

  2. 02

    Choose one topic

    Choose a clear topic for the page and check that another page does not cover the same thing.

  3. 03

    Agree the content

    Set who the page is for, what it should answer, the facts we can confirm, useful links and the next step.

  4. 04

    Plan the page

    Agree the headings and sections, and decide where proof and next steps belong.

  5. 05

    Write the copy

    Write clear, original copy and check the facts with Elite Fit before approval.

  6. 06

    Build the page

    Create an editable WordPress page that works on phones and computers, with useful images and links.

  7. 07

    Set page details

    Add a page title and short description, choose its web address and set how search engines can include it.

  8. 08

    Review and publish

    Check the copy, phone layout, links and search settings. Publish after approval and check that search engines can reach the page.

In addition to the 12–15 core website pages. Foundation / Growth / Max: 22 / 40 / 70 annual SEO pages.

08 — Monthly optimisation and reporting · D14

Maintain and improve search rankings through ongoing optimisation.

Every Phase 2 package includes monthly tracking, one priority improvement and a report. We use the results to see what is changing and agree what to improve next. Search positions, visits and sales depend on search engines and the visitor experience; page counts do not guarantee them.

01

Search results and page visits

See which pages people find and visit, and where search results are changing.

02

Page text and links

Check page copy, titles, descriptions, headings and links between pages for improvements.

03

Technical checks

Check that links work, pages load quickly and search engines can reach the right pages.

04

Routes to enquiries

Review how visitors move from a page to an enquiry or booking, using available website data.

05

Make and check one change

Make one agreed priority improvement each month, then check the result.

06

Monthly report and next steps

Published pages, available impressions, clicks, search positions and tracked enquiries, plus completed work and next priorities.
